metadata.description: Rajib Bahar's Claude Code plugins: staff-kit (engineering standards, skills, agents, guards) and market-watch (live market data in the session).

plugins.name: staff-kit
plugins.description: Staff-level engineering standards: 25 skills, 19 model-routed agents, 12 commands, 19 rules, tiered contexts, and a destructive-ops guard hook. Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and cost-disciplined multi-agent work.

plugins.name: market-watch
plugins.description: Stock ticker in the status line, /quote pane, price alerts, a market-context band, and a quote tool the model can call.
